parameters.name: Dimension
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: DimensionValue
parameters.description: The cause of the modification failure.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description:
The resource ID of the parameter type.    
You can leave this parameter unspecified when you call this operation to modify cluster parameters. In the case of tenant parameters, pass the tenant ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro modify-parameters --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --dimension-value t4qx80000 --dimension TENANT --parameters Name_:_connect_timeout_,_Value_:_20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro ModifyParameters --region cn-hangzhou --Parameters 'Name_:_connect_timeout_,_Value_:_20' --DimensionValue t4qx80000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --Dimension TENANT
